en:
There's a cooking programme on.
Someone is folding a very large omelette.
text:
E o emisiune de gătit.
Cineva împăturește o omletă uriașă.

en: The sink is spotless. Mom must have just washed up.
text: Chiuveta strălucește. Sigur mama tocmai a spălat vasele.

en: The draining board. A stack of plates is drying.
text: Uscătorul de vase. Un teanc de farfurii se usucă.

en: The fridge is full of good things to eat.
